name: Envoquee Hair Regrowth Serum Kit
summary: A complete at-home scalp ritual in one black-and-gold gift box: Envoquee Hair Regrowth Serum, an Anti Septic prep spray and a 540-needle derma roller with case. Designed to support healthier, fuller-looking hair.

details.ingredients: Minoxidil 5%, Biotin, D-Panthenol, Wheat Protein, Ethanol
details.results_timeline: Minoxidil usually needs 3–6 months of regular use before any change can be seen, and results vary from person to person. Some people notice extra shedding in the first weeks; this is common and usually settles. Any benefit fades if you stop using it. It is not a cure for hair loss.
details.warnings: Contains minoxidil 5% and alcohol (ethanol). For external use on the scalp only. Not for pregnant or breastfeeding women, or anyone under 18. Consult a doctor before use, especially if you have a heart condition, high or low blood pressure, or a scalp condition. Stop and see a doctor if you get chest pain, a fast heartbeat, dizziness, sudden weight gain, swelling of the hands or feet, or scalp irritation. Keep away from eyes. Flammable: keep away from flame.
